Hyper-Neural Memory Terminal: a 3D WebGL brain + long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
DeepHippo
Hyper-Neural Memory Terminal for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
Every conversation, workspace, tool call and long-term memory you have in dsh,
rendered as a living 3D brain that fires, dreams, and gets to know you better over time.
English · 简体中文
## What is it?
After a few weeks with dsh, your history turns into a long scrolling list. Which project burned the
most tokens? What were you working on last week? Where is that conversation about the payment callba
ck? And what has the AI actually learned about how you work?
**DeepHippo** puts all of it inside a brain. Once installed, a 🧠 button appears in the bottom-right
corner of dsh. Press `Ctrl+Alt+H` and the screen turns into a neural network of roughly 120,000 part
icles, firing in real time:
| Brain region | What it shows from dsh |
| 🟡 **Hippocampus** (two golden arcs) | Each conversation is an episodic memory trace. Newer ones si

t near the head and glow brighter; live conversations keep firing |
| 🔵 **Cortex** | Workspaces. Eac

h one owns a patch of cortex, wired to its conversations |
| 💗 **Prefrontal / cingulate / temporo-pa
rietal** | Long-term memory: identity, preferences, work habits, long-running projects and constrain

ts, each in its own region |
| 🟠 **Motor cortex** | Tools (pwsh, grep, web_fetch…), sized by call co

unt |
| 🟣 **Cerebellum** | Skills, clustered by domain (web / data / devops / ml…) |
| ⚪ **Brainstem

** | Models (deepseek-v4-pro / flash / reasoner…) with their cost |
| 🔷 **Fornix and fiber tracts**
| Shared memory (AGENTS.md) and the links between regions |

## Features

**Memory you can see**
- 🧠 A WebGL brain of about 120k particles: cortex point cloud, 3,000 neurons,

5,000+ synapses, 850 fiber tracts, with bloom
- ⚡ Live activity: new conversations, updates and mem

ory writes send ripples from their node and signals along the fibers
- 🔍 Search conversations, tools

, skills, workspaces and models; press Enter to fly there
- 🖱 Click any node for details: per-turn s
ummaries and the session ID for conversations; open or reveal files in Explorer

**A dashboard that thinks**
- 📊 Total and active conversations, token count, cost, tool calls, skill

s, and a daily token sparkline
- 🏆 Rankings for tools, models (with cost) and workspaces; click one

to highlight it in the brain
- ⏱ Timeline of conversations and tokens per day; drag across it to fil

the brain
- ⏱ Timeline of conversations and tokens per day; drag across it to filter to a date range

**Four brainwave modes**
- θ **Awake**: the default, with a slow rotation
- γ **Focus**: high-freque

ncy oscillation, the whole network fires faster
- ☾ **Sleep consolidation**: the hippocampus replays

conversations into the cortex one by one
- ⏵ **Replay**: lights up your memories in order, starting
from your first conversation

**And also**
- ✂ Cutaway along sagittal, coronal or horizontal planes with a slider; 🎬 guided camera

tour; 🔊 firing sounds; 📷 screenshot; ⛶ fullscreen
- Toggle cortex, fibers, network, bloom and label

s independently
- 🌐 English and Chinese UI: follows your system language, switch any time with the *

*中文 / EN** button
- Adaptive quality and dynamic resolution, so integrated GPUs work too; falls back
to a 2D view without WebGL
## Long-term memory
DeepHippo doesn't just draw your memory. It also keeps one.
- **Automatic consolidation**: once a conversation has been quiet for 3 minutes, the new turns (your
words plus the start of each reply) go to the model you normally use. It extracts long-term facts a
bout you in five categories: identity and background, preferences and style, work habits, long-runni
ng projects, and constraints. It also writes a one-line summary for each workspace. Duplicates merge
(strength +1); stale facts are updated or removed. Sub-agent sessions are skipped, since those word

s aren't yours.
- **Available in every conversation**: memories are injected as a global system prom

pt into every dsh workspace and conversation, and take effect on your next message.
- **You're in ch
arge**: tell dsh "remember…", "from now on…" or "forget…", and it updates memory right away with the
`memory_remember` / `memory_forget` / `memory_search` tools. Facts you asked it to remember are nev
er removed by automatic consolidation. You can also edit, pin or delete memories in the brain's Memo

ry panel.
- **Safe by default**: anything that looks like a password, API key, token or private key

is rejected. In the prompt, memories are marked as background information, not instructions.

## Privacy and security
- **Local, read-only, no telemetry**: data comes only from `~/.dsh` on your machine (conversation in
dex, AGENTS.md, scene memory, skills). The visualization uploads nothing, and three.js is bundled, w
ith no CDN. The only thing that leaves your machine is automatic memory consolidation, which uses th

e model you already configured in dsh.
- **Trust fence**: every route under `/dsh-hippocampus/*` onl
y accepts loopback requests (or ones the dsh host fence allows) and rejects cross-site and cross-ori

gin requests. If the host fence throws, the request is rejected.
- **No arbitrary paths**: "open" an
d "reveal" only accept node IDs from the latest `/graph` response. "Open" is limited to text files a

nd folders, and every write must come from the local machine.
- These rules are covered by automated

ry write must come from the local machine.
- These rules are covered by automated tests: `npm test`.
